## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
The *Koṇḍaññabuddhavaṁsa* is the biographical section of the *Buddhavaṁsa* dedicated to the past Buddha Koṇḍañña [SuttaCentral; Gaffney 2003]. Following the account of Buddha Dīpaṅkara, it establishes a biographical schema utilized across the remaining past buddha biographies in the collection [Gaffney 2003]. The text concisely enumerates the cardinal details of Koṇḍañña's life, including his city of origin, parentage, the size of his disciple retinue, the foremost male and female disciples, his personal attendant, the species of his bodhi tree, his physical stature, and his lifespan [Gaffney 2003]. Embedded within the narrative is the account of the Bodhisatta (the future Gotama Buddha), recording the gift offered by the Bodhisatta to Koṇḍañña and Koṇḍañña's subsequent prophecy (*byākaraṇa*) confirming his future buddhahood [Gaffney 2003]. Notably, unlike most other biographies in the *Buddhavaṁsa*, the explicit resolution (*adhiṭṭhāna*) by the Bodhisatta to fulfill the ten perfections (*pāramī*) is omitted in the *Koṇḍaññabuddhavaṁsa* [Gaffney 2003].
Verses from the *Koṇḍaññabuddhavaṁsa* are directly cited and commented upon in the prose of the *Jātakanidāna* (*Jātakanidānakathā*) [Gaffney 2003]. Automatic text-reuse analysis shows extensive internal Pali parallels across canonical and paracanonical literature, sharing substantial passages with the *Buddhavaṁsa-aṭṭhakathā*, the *Apadāna-aṭṭhakathā*, the *Jātaka-aṭṭhakathā*, the *Dhammasaṅgaṇi-aṭṭhakathā*, and other chapters of the *Buddhavaṁsa* such as the *Kassapabuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 26) and *Vipassībuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 21) [DharmaNexus]. Furthermore, DharmaNexus identifies cross-linguistic textual alignments with the Sanskrit *Mahāvastu-avadāna*, the Tibetan translation of the *Jātakanidāna*, and the Chinese *Dīrghāgama* [DharmaNexus].
